turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Um, okay. What does invasive mean? That sounds scary.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Invasive means the cancer cells have grown out of the milk duct into the surrounding breast tissue.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: The pathologist also tested the tumor for hormone receptors. It's estrogen receptor and progesterone receptor positive, and HER2 negative.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: I don't know what any of that means, honestly.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Because it's HER2 negative, hormone-blocking pills won't work for you.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: It sits in the middle of the scale. The next step is to meet with the breast surgeon and the oncologist to plan treatment.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: That depends on a few more results, and we'll go through all of it at that visit.
